meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here, Hale. It's 4:15 and I have a call at 4:40, so tell me why Owen has a zero.
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. Owen found out from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class. What was the basis for the zero, Hale?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
I'm writing down November 2. Where was this conversation, and was anyone else there? Show me the note you made that day.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
I'm writing down October 15. People change their argument between an outline and an essay, Hale; it's called revising. You still haven't put the outline or your note from the second in front of me.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

I'm writing down Thursday at 8:15 and Friday at 3 PM. You want my son to sit a rewrite on Thursday on a promise that arrives after it, with the zero still showing on his phone. I want it in writing before Thursday, and I want to know who else will be in that room.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero come off the gradebook, that any rewrite offer and the promise that nothing goes on Owen's record reach me in writing before Thursday, and that you tell me who else will be in the room. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, the record promise in writing before the rewrite, and the names of anyone else present.
What moved her: "I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake." because it owned the process failure in one sentence, and it earned a small sign of ground.
What cost ground: "I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM." because the promise would arrive after the rewrite, and you made the offer before showing the note and outline she asked for.
Try next time: when she asked to see your note from the second and the outline, put them in front of her before offering the rewrite.
